# By the Numbers: Top 10 Pharma & Biopharma Companies

 For the first time, Lilly takes the top spot with $65.2 billion in pharmaceutical sales. 

June 25, 2026

By: Kristin Brooks

Managing Editor, Contract Pharma

#### Adobe Stock I #1817325072 

A preview to Contract Pharma’s Guide to the Top 20 Pharma and Biopharma Companies, the following is a list of the top 10 Pharma and Biopharma companies by Pharmaceutical sales in U.S. Millions for FY2025. (excludes consumer healthcare, medical device, diagnostics division sales)

Contract Pharma’s annual guide to the 20 biggest Pharma and Biopharma players highlights key financials, top selling drugs, acquisitions and alliances, drug approvals, pipeline advances, executive moves, and more. Coming soon, Contract Pharma’s July/August Top 20 Companies Report!
